SUPERSEDES.REASON: Independent review requires authority, negative-obligation, reconciliation-binding, canonicalization and stability repairs.

PRIMARY_SPEC.LOGICAL_FILENAME: แอป [NEXY-IGNIS] ที่กำลังพัฒนา.docx

MATRIX_EXPORT.FORMAT: UTF-8 parsed-text export containing CSV sheets

PARAGRAPH_INDEX_CONTRACT.AUTHORITY_COMPARISON_RULE: All temporal/authority comparisons use transformed one-based primary DOCX paragraph numbers, never raw matrix paragraph numbers.

NORMALIZATION_CONTRACT.CSV_PARSER: RFC4180-compatible quoting for comma-separated rows; doubled quote escapes; quoted commas/newlines preserved
NORMALIZATION_CONTRACT.BUILD_MATRIX_EXTRACTION: Read only the first sheet named Build Matrix from MATRIX_EXPORT, from its exact header through the row before the next <PARSED TEXT FOR SHEET marker.
NORMALIZATION_CONTRACT.STRING_RULE: Decode CSV cell, normalize Unicode NFC, preserve non-empty content exactly including leading/trailing whitespace; do not semantic-trim.
NORMALIZATION_CONTRACT.EMPTY_CELL_RULE: An empty decoded CSV cell becomes JSON null. Nullable fields are always present with null; keys are never omitted.
NORMALIZATION_CONTRACT.INTEGER_RULE: index, Source_Doc_Paragraph and Source_Extraction_Seq are base-10 JSON integers; non-integer or missing values are invalid.
NORMALIZATION_CONTRACT.BOOLEAN_RULE: Schema booleans are JSON true/false only.
NORMALIZATION_CONTRACT.SET_ARRAY_RULE: Set-like arrays are deduplicated then sorted by UTF-8 byte ordering of their canonical string representation.
NORMALIZATION_CONTRACT.REFERENCE_ARRAY_RULE: Primary-source reference arrays sort by paragraph_1_based ascending, then anchor UTF-8 bytes.
NORMALIZATION_CONTRACT.ENTRY_SORT_RULE: Root entries sort by source_entry_id UTF-8 bytes; duplicate source_entry_id is invalid.
NORMALIZATION_CONTRACT.JCS_RULE: Apply RFC8785/JCS only after this normalization contract.
NORMALIZATION_CONTRACT.SELF_REFERENCE_RULE: ROOT_HASH is stored outside ROOT_OBJECT and never hashed into itself.

SOURCE_ENUMERATION_ROOT_HASH.PURPOSE: Exhaustive normalized source-material identity; never the active-build denominator.
SOURCE_ENUMERATION_ROOT_HASH.MATRIX_ROW_INCLUSION: All 837 Build Matrix rows must appear exactly once.
SOURCE_ENUMERATION_ROOT_HASH.PRIMARY_OMISSION_RULE: Any normative final DOC-C obligation not represented by a matrix row must be normalized as PRIMARY_FINAL_DOC_C_OMISSION before this root can be activation-ready.
SOURCE_ENUMERATION_ROOT_HASH.COVERAGE_GATE: primary_final_doc_c_coverage_unmatched_count MUST equal 0 before SOURCE_ENUMERATION_ROOT_HASH is activation-ready.
FORBIDDEN_SHORTCUTS: 837 structurally valid matrix rows do not prove exhaustive final DOC-C coverage when known primary omissions exist.
Do not treat workbook declared SHA256 as the byte hash of MATRIX_EXPORT.
Do not use source enumeration as active-build authority or implementation proof.

AUTHORITY_RECONCILIATION_ROOT_HASH.PURPOSE: Complete authority decision manifest covering every source-enumeration entry exactly once.
AUTHORITY_RECONCILIATION_ROOT_HASH.ACTIVE_AUTHORITY_RULE: Every ACTIVE decision MUST contain at least one final_doc_c_normative_refs_1_based reference within primary paragraphs 9886..10499. Document class labels alone never confer build authority.
AUTHORITY_RECONCILIATION_ROOT_HASH.NEGATIVE_OBLIGATION_RULE: Final DOC-C MUST_NOT/non-goal requirements are ACTIVE_FINAL_DOC_C_NEGATIVE with polarity PROHIBIT and remain in the active-build denominator.
AUTHORITY_RECONCILIATION_ROOT_HASH.DOC_B_RULE: DOC-B may constrain interpretation but cannot independently create an active-build obligation without a final DOC-C normative incorporation reference.
AUTHORITY_RECONCILIATION_ROOT_HASH.DOC_D_RULE: DOC-D may provide supporting design detail but cannot independently create an active-build obligation; active use requires explicit final DOC-C normative incorporation.
AUTHORITY_RECONCILIATION_ROOT_HASH.HISTORICAL_RULE: Pre-FINAL historical rows cannot become ACTIVE without explicit final DOC-C normative incorporation evidence.
AUTHORITY_RECONCILIATION_ROOT_HASH.COMPLETENESS_RULE: entry_count MUST equal SOURCE_ENUMERATION entry_count, source_entry_id sets MUST be identical, and unresolved_count MUST equal count(CONFLICT|UNKNOWN).

ACTIVE_BUILD_REQUIREMENT_ROOT_HASH.PURPOSE: Stable immutable denominator of current positive and negative build obligations.

ENTRY_TYPE_CONTRACT.final_doc_c_normative_refs_1_based: nonempty array of {paragraph_1_based: integer, anchor: string}
ENTRY_TYPE_CONTRACT.supporting_refs: array of canonical reference objects; empty array allowed
ENTRY_TYPE_CONTRACT.dependencies_identity: array of source_entry_id strings; empty array allowed
ENTRY_TYPE_CONTRACT.validation_acceptance_criteria: array of immutable acceptance-criterion strings; nonempty

ACTIVE_BUILD_REQUIREMENT_ROOT_HASH.INCLUSION_RULE: Include exactly reconciliation entries with ACTIVE_FINAL_DOC_C_POSITIVE or ACTIVE_FINAL_DOC_C_NEGATIVE.
ACTIVE_BUILD_REQUIREMENT_ROOT_HASH.AUTHORITY_RULE: Each entry must retain the same final DOC-C normative refs and polarity proven by the bound reconciliation root.
ACTIVE_BUILD_REQUIREMENT_ROOT_HASH.STABILITY_RULE: Mutable implementation/accounting states are forbidden from this denominator root.
ACTIVE_BUILD_REQUIREMENT_ROOT_HASH.MUTABLE_ACCOUNTING_LOCATION: Requirement accounting is maintained in separate versioned ledgers/evidence and is evaluated against this stable denominator during closure.
ACTIVE_BUILD_REQUIREMENT_ROOT_HASH.MUST_NOT_VERIFICATION_RULE: PROHIBIT obligations require positive evidence that forbidden capability/behavior is absent or unreachable; omission from implementation is not self-proving.
FORBIDDEN_SHORTCUTS: Do not include DOC-B, DOC-D, supplements, or historical rows solely from their source labels.
Do not omit final DOC-C negative obligations.
Do not materialize if bound reconciliation unresolved_count is nonzero.
Do not use the legacy current-ish aggregate of 773 rows as this denominator.

DEPLOYMENT_EVIDENCE_REQUIREMENT_ROOT_HAS.PURPOSE: Stable denominator of DOC-E deployment/runtime proof obligations, separate from implementation.
DEPLOYMENT_EVIDENCE_REQUIREMENT_ROOT_HAS.INCLUSION_RULE: Include exactly reconciliation entries classified DEPLOYMENT_EVIDENCE_ONLY with valid DOC-E primary refs.
DEPLOYMENT_EVIDENCE_REQUIREMENT_ROOT_HAS.SEPARATION_RULE: Deployment evidence cannot satisfy, replace, or increase ACTIVE_BUILD_REQUIREMENT_ROOT obligations.
DEPLOYMENT_EVIDENCE_REQUIREMENT_ROOT_HAS.STABILITY_RULE: Mutable evidence status is forbidden from this denominator root and is tracked separately.

CURRENT_MATRIX_SCOPE_COUNTS.LEGACY_CURRENT_ISH_AGGREGATE_773: 12 + 547 + 127 + 87; this is not the literal CURRENT_BUILD count and is not an authority denominator.

GLOBAL_VALIDATION_GATES: Source enumeration coverage gate must be zero unmatched.
Source enumeration and reconciliation source_entry_id sets must be identical.
Every active-build entry must bind final DOC-C normative authority.
Every final DOC-C MUST_NOT/non-goal is represented as a PROHIBIT obligation.
No mutable accounting/evidence status appears in denominator roots.
All root objects pass normalization and independent JCS/SHA-256 recomputation.
